meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止。点开图标即可启动、停止或重启服务。
howto.when: 在 macOS 上运行此技能时触发;前提是已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc),非 macOS 会停下并提示不支持。

howto.what_en: Adds a bolt icon to the macOS menu bar with a green or red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running, and lets you start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run this skill on macOS; it requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc). On other platforms it stops and says it is macOS only.

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status icon to my menu bar
say_en.note: Compiles the Swift binary and installs a launchd service

say_en.text: Check whether the menu bar status icon is installed
say_en.note: Uses launchctl to look for a PID

say_en.text: The status icon didn't show up, help me debug it
say_en.note: Checks swiftc and the launchd job
